rules.title: 📃・Rules
rules.description:
_____

These are our server rules. Please follow them so everyone can enjoy the community.
rules.rule1Description: Respect every user, regardless of your opinion of them. Treat others as you would like to be treated.
rules.rule2Description: Keep profanity to a minimum. Any insulting language toward another user is forbidden.
rules.rule3Description: Do not send many small messages in a row or disrupt the conversation with spam.
rules.rule4Title: 4. No pornographic, adult, or other NSFW material
rules.rule4Description: This community server is not intended for sharing this type of material.
rules.rule5Description: We do not allow advertising for other communities or feeds. You may post relevant content in the media channel.
rules.rule6Title: 6. No offensive names or profile images
rules.rule6Description: You will be asked to change your name or image if staff considers it inappropriate.
rules.rule7Description: Raids and mentions of raids are not allowed.
rules.rule8Description: Threats, abuse, doxxing, and other malicious behavior are strictly forbidden.
rules.rule9Description: You can find them here: https://discordapp.com/guidelines
rules.rule10Title: 10. Do not join voice channels without permission
rules.rule10Description: If there is a free spot, ask whether you may join first and leave if your presence is not wanted.

More options on the server? Become a real Booster and enjoy many benefits.
boosterperks.field2: Send messages with an attached sound.
